description.value: The Turkey House & Deli is a specialty deli shop on King George Boulevard in Tsawwassen, BC. The name suggests a focus on turkey and deli provisions, making it a potential stop for cyclists seeking ready-to-eat or prepared foods. It sits in the South Delta area near the Tsawwassen ferry terminal, a corridor used by touring cyclists travelling to and from Vancouver Island.
